items.title: Super Micro Computer Revenue Surges on AI Infrastructure Demand
items.summary: The server company’s first-quarter revenue rose to $19.95 billion, up from $5.02 billion a year prior, as customers continued spending heavily on artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

items.title: Apple earnings beat expectations, but rising chip costs worry investors

items.title: DuPont Swings to a Profit and Lifts Outlook
items.summary: DuPont swung to a third-quarter profit of $123 million, or 91 cents a share, from a loss of $123 million, or 88 cents a share, a year earlier.
